title: デビュー戦の後に・ビッグな新人

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Due her sheer size and strength, Hishi Akebono leaves quite an impression on the public.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She comes up with two ways to make her races even more satisfying for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to become even more powerful and really rev up the fans. In other words, she wants as many people as possible to know about her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To meet her goals, we keep training hard while finding ways to draw in more fans!
